Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: User clicks a seat; this starts a timed reservation

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Atomic NX lock with a 10-minute TTL; only one user can hold a seat

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A booking in 'in-progress' is written; client is sent to payment

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Client tokenises the card with Stripe.js (servers never see card numbers)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On success, Stripe calls back; use bookingId as idempotency key because webhooks retry. If the lock expired mid-payment and the DB write loses, refund

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Before seeing the seat map, users wait in a queue with live position and estimated wait

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An operator-enabled throttle releases users in batches as tickets sell

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only admitted sessions may call the reservation endpoint

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • NFRs: availability for browse/search, consistency for booking (never double book), 10M users on one event, search < 500 ms, reads ≈ 100× writes

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Locking options compared: long DB transaction (bad) → status+expiry+cron (good) → implicit status with expiry in a short transaction (great) → Redis TTL lock (great, chosen)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Shared DB between services is fine here: bookings, tickets and events are tightly coupled and need ACID transactions
